prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign in with your existing account email to automatically restore saved pets and sync your cloud data."]
1: ["Choose Your Companion", "Swipe through available pet styles to find your perfect desktop buddy."]
2: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your pet for actions and settings, click-and-drag to move across screens, or double-click to talk."]
3: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Choose a classic pre-made pet for instant desktop fun, or generate a unique companion from your photos."]
4: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "Make sure desktop overlay permissions are enabled if your pet window does not automatically pop up."]
5: []
6: ["Upload well-lit, centered photos showing your pet's face clearly for the best AI rendering results."]
7: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "In less than 2 minutes, your personalized animated companion will come to life right on your screen."]
8: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is ready on your screen! Use your mouse to interact, drag, or open pet controls anytime."]
9: ["You will receive a desktop alert when your pet is fully rendered and ready to play."]
